def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    markers=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==5]
    # Identify marked source motif by its populated neighboring cells; copy all nonzero relative cells to isolated 5.
    source=[]
    for r,c in markers:
        cells=[]
        for rr in range(max(0,r-5),min(len(grid),r+6)):
            for cc in range(max(0,c-5),min(len(grid[0]),c+6)):
                v=grid[rr][cc]
                if v and v!=5: cells.append((rr-r,cc-c,v))
        if cells: source=cells; origin=(r,c); break
    if source:
        for r,c in markers:
            if (r,c)==origin: continue
            for dr,dc,v in source:
                rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
                if 0<=rr<len(g) and 0<=cc<len(g[0]): g[rr][cc]=v
            g[r][c]=0
    return g

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    marks=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==5]
    # Source colored shape attached to one marker; copy it so that the marker of the copied shape
    # lands on the other marker, retaining its relative orientation and offsets.
    objects=[]
    seen=set()
    for r in range(len(grid)):
        for c in range(len(grid[0])):
            if grid[r][c] and grid[r][c]!=5 and (r,c) not in seen:
                stack=[(r,c)];seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop();cells.append((y,x,grid[y][x]))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=yy<len(grid) and 0<=xx<len(grid[0]) and grid[yy][xx] not in (0,5) and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                            seen.add((yy,xx));stack.append((yy,xx))
                objects.append(cells)
    # Select largest colored object and nearest marker as its anchor.
    if not marks or not objects: return g
    cells=max(objects,key=len)
    mr,mc=min(marks,key=lambda p:min(abs(p[0]-y)+abs(p[1]-x) for y,x,v in cells))
    # transfer using relative offsets from nearest marked pixel, infer target shape orientation as same
    target=next((p for p in marks if p!=(mr,mc)),None)
    if target:
        tr,tc=target
        for y,x,v in cells:
            yy,xx=tr+(y-mr),tc+(x-mc)
            if 0<=yy<len(g) and 0<=xx<len(g[0]): g[yy][xx]=v
        g[tr][tc]=0
    return g
